policies.policyname: collection_cakes_authenticated_all
collection_cakes_public_select
policies.qual:
((available = true) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM collections c
  WHERE ((c.id = collection_cakes.collection_id) AND (c.status = 'active'::collection_status)))))

policies.policyname: collection_cakes_public_select_customer_history
policies.qual:
((available = true) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM collections c
  WHERE ((c.id = collection_cakes.collection_id) AND (c.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::collection_status, 'archived'::collection_status])) AND (c.purpose = ANY (ARRAY['monthly'::text, 'special'::text])) AND ((c.purpose = 'monthly'::text) OR (c.website_override = true) OR (c.show_in_past_menu = true))))))

library_cake_photos_public_select_catalogue_history
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((library_cakes cake
     JOIN collection_cakes cc ON ((cc.library_cake_id = cake.id)))
     JOIN collections c ON ((c.id = cc.collection_id)))
  WHERE ((cake.id = library_cake_photos.cake_id) AND (cc.available = true) AND (c.status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::collection_status, 'archived'::collection_status])) AND (c.purpose = ANY (ARRAY['monthly'::text, 'special'::text])) AND ((c.purpose = 'monthly'::text) OR (c.website_override = true) OR (c.show_in_past_menu = true)))))
